card.name: Hex digits inside addresses and hashes
card.fires_on: The character right after 0 in a hex address like 0x, and pieces of hex strings or IDs in URLs and system logs. It is strongest on the x in a memory address.

modes.label: Hex address marker
modes.description: The x in a 0x memory address, where hex digits follow.
modes.example: It says that the C++ object is at address 0<<x>>010820c0

modes.label: Hex string pieces
modes.description: Single characters inside long hex-like IDs or hashes in URLs and image names.

modes.label: Device log numbers
modes.description: Numbers in device lines from system logs such as atapibus0.
modes.example: See if your system has some CD drive: dmesg | grep ^cdcd0 at atapibus<<0>> drive 0: <CD-R/R

card.plain: It fires inside computer codes made of hex-style characters, such as memory addresses and long IDs, and not in normal prose.
